learning_objective: 🎯 Let us play hide and seek with objects to learn about different views, maps, and directions!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Objects look different depending on where you stand! A toy car looks like a box from the top, but you can see its wheels from the side.
A map is like a drawing made from the top view. It helps us find hidden treasures and our way around places easily.
We use words like left, right, front, and back to tell our friends exactly where to hide or where to go!

fun_activity.title: 🗺️ My Room Map
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a simple map of your bedroom from the top view. Show where your bed, door, and toy box are kept!

quick_recap: ⭐ Things look very different from the top, front, and side.
⭐ Maps are special drawings that help us find places.
⭐ Directions like left and right guide us on our way.
